_note: copy to local/config.json (gitignored); every key is optional. Paths may start with ~ (this user's home). Without a config: sibling checkouts next to this repository (../orchid-sage, ../orchid-data, ../orchid-brand, ../open-tdb, ../PhaseForgePlus) and data/runs/ for the campaign directories. 'hosts' maps the machine labels of the records (studio, spark1..spark4) to this machine's host names; 'private' lists names scripts/check_public.py fails on.
